app_fee.value: International applicants to graduate research courses (PhD) pay no application fee; the AUD 154 fee applies to coursework applicants.
app_fee.quote: All new direct international applicants pay a non-refundable fee of AUD$154 for each application. | Applying for a graduate research course | (Note: Graduate coursework applicants are not exempt.) | You will not be prompted to pay the application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate research applicants are exempt from the application fee, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: Applying for a graduate research course | (Note: Graduate coursework applicants are not exempt.) | You will not be prompted to pay the application fee.

gre_general.value: Graduate research degrees at Melbourne require a bachelor honours or master research degree; the GRE General is not required.
gre_general.quote: In order to be considered for entry, applicants must have completed: | a four-year Bachelor degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component | a Masters degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component

toefl_min.value: Each research course sets its own English score (shown on the course page's Entry requirements tab, which was blocked).
toefl_min.quote: Each graduate research course has a specific English language standard you must meet. The required scores are published on each course page.

also.quote: English language test score requirements for graduate study vary by faculty and course.

ielts_min.value: Each research course sets its own English score (shown on the course page's Entry requirements tab, which was blocked).
ielts_min.quote: Each graduate research course has a specific English language standard you must meet. The required scores are published on each course page.

also.quote: English language test score requirements for graduate study vary by faculty and course.

english_waiver.value: Applicants who have completed tertiary study taught and assessed entirely in English likely meet the requirement without an additional test.
english_waiver.quote: If you’re from an English-speaking background or have completed tertiary study taught and assessed entirely in English, you will likely meet the University’s English language requirements without needing to take an additional test.

notes: All graduate research applications go through the University's central online portal; English scores are set per course. Course-page tabs (Entry requirements, How to apply, Fees) on study.unimelb.edu.au were blocked by Cloudflare for most courses.
